priorityList: Pre-combat: Cast Aimed Shot and Steady Shot before the pull, and ensure your pet is summoned if using the Unbreakable Bond talent.
Cast Black Arrow whenever available as your highest priority.
Cast Trueshot on cooldown, ideally syncing it with the start of the fight or high Bullseye stacks.
Use offensive racial abilities (Berserking, Blood Fury, Fireblood) and combat potions while Trueshot is active.
Sync 'On-Use' trinkets with Trueshot windows, particularly when Trueshot has more than 14 seconds of duration remaining.
Cast Rapid Fire if the Unload talent is active and you have low Bulletstorm stacks (<10) or the target is below 20% health.
Cast Arcane Shot to consume Precise Shots procs.
Cast Rapid Fire if the Bulletstorm buff is about to expire (duration is less than an Aimed Shot cast).
Cast Aimed Shot to prevent charge capping, prioritizing targets with Spotter's Mark.
Cast Rapid Fire on cooldown to generate Focus and deal damage.
Cast Steady Shot as a filler when you have no other actions available and need to generate Focus.
